## Level3D

`class` from [`src/Core3D/Level/Level3D.js`](../../src/Core3D/Level/Level3D.js)

Base level for current Render3D games with optional canvas UI and physics. Extend this class and implement `BuildScene()` to add objects, lights and skyboxes; the standard level lifecycle renders and disposes the scene.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[options]` | `Object` | Canvas, rendering and simulation settings. |
| `[options.canvasId="gameCanvas3D"]` | `string` | Render canvas identifier. |
| `[options.uiCanvasId="gameCanvasUI"]` | `string` | Overlay UI canvas identifier. |
| `[options.width=960]` | `number` | Logical render width. |
| `[options.height=540]` | `number` | Logical render height. |
| `[options.clearColor]` | `number[]` | RGBA clear color. |
| `[options.useUI=true]` | `boolean` | Whether to create `ScreenUI`. |
| `[options.usePhysics=true]` | `boolean` | Whether to create `PhysicsWorld3D`. |

**Example**

```js
class FirstLevel extends Level3D {
BuildScene() {
this.scene.Add(new DirectionalLight({ castShadow: true }));
}
}
```

### Documented Methods

#### `BuildScene()`

Scene construction hook implemented by a game level.

**Returns:** `void`

## SceneManifest3D

`class` from [`src/Core3D/Render3D/Scene/SceneManifest3D.js`](../../src/Core3D/Render3D/Scene/SceneManifest3D.js)

Creates simple Render3D scenes from JSON-compatible game manifests. A game or an authoring tool owns the manifest data; this factory converts its camera, lights, primitives and basic materials into runtime objects.

**Example**

```js
const { scene, camera } = SceneManifest3D.Create(levelManifest, {
aspect: canvas.width / canvas.height,
});
```

### Documented Methods

#### `static Create()`

Builds a scene, camera and manifest-owned content collection.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[manifest={}]` | `Object` | Scene manifest definition. |
| `[options]` | `Object` | Creation context. |
| `[options.aspect=1]` | `number` | Camera aspect ratio. |

**Returns:** `Object` - Object containing `scene`, `camera`, `lights` and `objects`.
#### `static CreateCamera()`

Creates a perspective camera from a manifest definition.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[definition={}]` | `Object` | Camera values. |
| `[aspect=1]` | `number` | Current viewport aspect ratio. |

**Returns:** `PerspectiveCamera` - Created camera.
#### `static Populate()`

Adds declared lights and primitive objects to an existing scene.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | `Scene3D` | Target scene. |
| `[manifest={}]` | `Object` | Scene manifest definition. |

**Returns:** `Object` - Added `lights` and `objects`.
#### `static CreateLight()`

Creates one supported light definition.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[definition={}]` | `Object` | Manifest light, selected by `type`. |

**Returns:** `Light` - Render3D light.
#### `static CreateObject()`

Creates a primitive mesh and applies its declared transform.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
